description: This Java class 'ServiceUtil' provides utility methods for handling service responses, error and success message formatting, security checks, and service parameter management within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ServiceUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling service responses, security, and message formatting within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the service result indicates an error based on the response message.

methods.name: isFailure
methods.description: Checks if the service result indicates a failure.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Checks if the service result indicates success (neither error nor failure).

methods.name: returnError
methods.description: Creates a result map indicating an error with a message.

methods.name: returnFailure
methods.description: Creates a result map indicating a failure with a message.

methods.name: returnProblem
methods.description: Constructs a detailed response map with error or success information, including nested messages.

methods.name: returnSuccess
methods.description: Creates a success response map with optional messages.

methods.name: returnMessage
methods.description: Builds a response map with a response code and message.

methods.name: getPartyIdCheckSecurity
methods.description: Performs security validation for partyId, ensuring user permissions or matching partyId.

methods.name: setMessages
methods.description: Sets error, event, or default messages as request attributes.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Retrieves and formats messages from service results and sets them in the request.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts error messages from a service result map.

methods.name: makeErrorMessage
methods.description: Constructs a formatted error message string from a result map with optional prefixes and suffixes.

methods.name: makeSuccessMessage
methods.description: Constructs a formatted success message string from a result map with optional prefixes and suffixes.

methods.name: makeMessageList
methods.description: Concatenates a list of messages with optional prefixes and suffixes.

methods.name: addErrors
methods.description: Extracts error messages from a call result and adds them to target list and map.

methods.name: genericDateCondition
methods.description: Checks if current date falls within fromDate and thruDate, returning a condition reply.

methods.name: getUserLogin
methods.description: Retrieves the user login, optionally as a different user.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale from context or default.

methods.name: makeContext
methods.description: Creates a context map from key-value pairs, ensuring keys are strings.

methods.name: setServiceFields
methods.description: Copies matching fields from input map to output map, adding userLogin if required.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the resource string identifier used for messages.
